parameters.name: autoSnapshotPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the target automatic snapshot policy.

parameters.name: diskIds
parameters.description: The IDs of one or more cloud disks. The value is a JSON array. Separate multiple cloud disk IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy and cloud disks. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
